import os

if os.path.exists("data/stablecoin_marketcap.csv"):
    df = pd.read_csv("data/stablecoin_marketcap.csv")

    # Security: Date parsing uses errors="coerce" to prevent Denial of Service (DoS) from unhandled DateParseError/ValueError if the CSV contains malformed data.
